Hi Engr. Kamruzzaman — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I saw your AK Red Rose / Barakah / Lakeview project page in Jolshiri Abashon. The 2,850 SFT, single-unit-per-floor positioning is exactly what NRBs shopping for a premium flat are looking for. The Palm Jumeirah founder story lands hard with that audience.

Here's the gap I see: every NRB buyer is browsing at 11pm-2am their time, but your 01979-600600 line is silent then. By the time you reply 12 hours later they've already messaged two competing Jolshiri projects. For a 30% down-payment, multi-crore lead, that lag is a serious leak.

I built an AI buyer agent that handles off-hours enquiries in your voice — answers the 5 questions every serious NRB asks (sqft, down-payment, construction status, handover date, registration), then books a video call with you in their morning / your evening. The agent also pushes construction-progress photos to buyers who've already booked, so you stop getting "is it on schedule?" WhatsApps at random hours.

I've built a working demo using your actual projects — happy to show you in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
